verdict.rationale: Brex's Bill Pay page covers every part of the story. Brex AI captures itemized invoice details, suggests the matching PO and drafts a payment. Multi-level approval flows route automatically by amount, vendor and role. Payments go out by ACH, check, wire or virtual card from any bank account or a Brex business account. Vendor onboarding links and a payments API with a create-vendor endpoint reinforce this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the AP workflow, since all evidence is vendor-authored.
